name: Tower Hamlets Plan 2031 Managing Growth and Sharing Benefits

housing-numbers.notes: Required housing is London Plan target (3,931 per year x 15 years). Allocated housing from site allocations without permission. Windfall allowance for sites under 10 units. Committed housing includes completed, under development and with planning permission (approximate figure from page 333). SHLAA sites without permission treated as broad locations.
